state.task: General advice for tuning an English letter-palindrome search: maximize length and readable connected English simultaneously. No project data, results, texts or private files supplied. Advice will be evaluated experimentally, not treated as proof.

strategy.instructions: Which general strategy best preserves readability while searching exact long palindromes?

criteria.grammar_residual: Grammar-preserving edits of exact parents, tracking residual letter constraints and sentence roles
criteria.frequency_only: Only maximize word frequency with a larger beam
criteria.repetition: Repeat short reversible phrases without a grammar constraint

penalties.instructions: Which general development tuning design avoids selecting a repetition penalty without a baseline?

criteria.paired_low: Paired penalty0,1,2,4 on development seeds at identical resource limits
criteria.insufficient: Numeric values cannot be justified a priori

validation.instructions: Which general validation supports a readability claim after automated tuning?

criteria.heldout_blind: Freeze parameters and evaluate held-out outputs with blinded human grammar, meaning and comprehension judgments and length-matched controls
criteria.ordinary_controls: Ordinary corpus prose versus shuffled words alone
criteria.tuning_judge: Selected outputs rated only by the same model used in tuning

length_cap.instructions: Which word-cap policy is valid for a specified minimum letter length?

criteria.feasibility_first: First prove cap times maximum vocabulary-word length can reach the target, then tune feasible caps with repetition diagnostics
criteria.fixed_small: Keep an arbitrary small fixed cap regardless of letter feasibility
criteria.unlimited: Use unlimited repeated words without diagnostics
